question: Should OpenClaw accept gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired plus always-on hot-mode restarts for gateway.auth.*, auth.profiles.*/auth.order.*, and provider SecretRef rotations as the public reload contract?
rationale: The change adds a public config key, changes config.patch/config.apply behavior in hot mode, and introduces unattended restarts for auth/provider config changes, so automation cannot choose the product contract for existing operators.

options.title: Approve split contract after proof/docs fixes
options.body: Keep routine hot-mode edits warn-and-keep by default, allow opt-in automatic restart, and always restart security-critical auth/provider credential changes once docs and proof are aligned.

options.title: Narrow to explicit writer intent or diagnostics
options.body: Avoid the new global config key and rely on explicit restart intent or health/drift diagnostics for doctor/configure flows.

options.title: Preserve old hot semantics
options.body: Reject unattended hot-mode restarts and require operators to use hybrid, manual restart, or a future migration path.

recommendation.title: Approve split contract after proof/docs fixes
recommendation.body: Keep routine hot-mode edits warn-and-keep by default, allow opt-in automatic restart, and always restart security-critical auth/provider credential changes once docs and proof are aligned.
